use IO.Std.write_line

occurrences(haystack: string, needle: string) -> int is
    let found mut = 0
    let at mut = haystack.index_of(needle)

    while at >= 0 do
        found = found + 1
        at = haystack.index_of(needle, at + needle.length)
    od

    found
si

write_line("{occurrences("the three truths", "th")}")
write_line("{occurrences("ababababab", "abab")}")
